description: Department of Elections - Number of members which each electoral district entitled to return
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with electoral matters, certifying the number of members each electoral district is entitled to return for parliamentary representation. It is issued by the Commissioner of Elections under constitutional authority (Article 98(8)) and contains a detailed schedule of electoral districts with their respective member allocations. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it involves electoral boundary representation and parliamentary seat allocations.
